For Honor cordially invites you to the Animus Entertainment experience!

The Naoe the Swift Hero Skin for Shinobi, Yasuke the Brave Hero Skin for Shugoki , and Eivor Wolf-Kissed Hero Skin for Beserker are available April 23, 2026.

About For Honor:
Carve a path of destruction through the battlefield fighting for guts, glory, and survival in For Honor. Enter the chaos of a raging war as a Hero from some of the greatest warrior legacies ever known. For Honor is a fast-paced and immersive experience, mixing skill with visceral, never-before-seen melee combat.

Enjoy incredible seasonal content, engaging campaign and thrilling multiplayer with friends online, or solo against AI.

#Ubisoft #ForHonor

description:
Found a bug while playing a Ubisoft game? This guide shows you how to use Ubisoft’s Bug Reporter tools to report issues, track existing bugs, and help improve your gameplay experience.

Ubisoft Bug Reporter tools allow players to submit issues, view reported bugs, and track their status so developers can investigate and resolve them.
